_comment: The `permissions` member of TokenResponse (AuthEndpoints.cs:1390-1397), which the console stores as a string[] (auth-store.ts) and reads with useHasPermission. Its shape is unchanged; this change adds one catalogued id, `contacts:contact:delete`, that can now appear in it, and the console's existing PermissionButton requires="contacts:contact:delete" on the contact card (contact-info.tsx) starts showing for its holders. Written 2026-11-05 by reading the code; nothing was run. The values are the effective permissions of the caller: its resolved tenant-role rows, or the RoleDefaultPermissions fallback of its role when it resolves none (AuthEndpoints.cs:544). Excerpts list only the contacts:contact:* ids per seeded template after this change (design D4, D5); every other id is unchanged and elided. quality_analyst holds no contacts:contact:* id today (RoleTemplateSeeder.cs:239-254, only contacts:conversation:read) and gains none, so its excerpt is empty (second spec audit F3).

fallbackAdmin._note: RoleDefaultPermissions.Admin mirrors the admin template (living spec rbac-permission-vocabulary), so it gains `contacts:contact:delete` too

example.case: the token response of an Admin user, excerpt
